newsitem.title: USA: Fort Wayne Natl to buy Ambassador Group.
newsitem.headline: Fort Wayne Natl to buy Ambassador Group.

text.p: Fort Wayne National Corp said Tuesday it entered into an agreement to acquire Ambassador Group Inc of Indianapolis, Ind. for undisclosed terms.

The acquisition will include the Ambassador Financial Division, a commercial leasing operation; Ambassador Realty Credit Division, a commercial real estate unit and First Lease and Equipment Consulting Corp, an equipment consulting corporation that provides third party leasing capabilities and portfolio servicing for 26 banks in the Midwest.
Ambassador, combined with Fort Wayne National's customer base, should produce revenues over the next four years of more than $75 million, Fort Wayne National said.
